headline.title: Celebrating 20 years of Google Translate: Fun facts, tips and new features to try
headline.summary: Google Translate marks its 20th anniversary with a celebration featuring fun facts, tips, and new features for users. The platform continues to evolve, enhancing its capabilities for real-time translation and user engagement.

articles.title: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
articles.summary: Sam Altman and Elon Musk are currently engaged in a trial regarding Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI, which alleges that the organization has strayed from its original mission of prioritizing humanity's benefit in AI development in favor of profit. The outcome of this case could significantly impact the direction and operations of OpenAI.

articles.title: Introducing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: Long-Context Multimodal Intelligence for Documents, Audio and Video Agents
articles.summary: NVIDIA has unveiled the Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, a new AI model designed for long-context multimodal intelligence, capable of processing and understanding documents, audio, and video. This advancement aims to enhance the capabilities of AI agents in handling complex tasks across various media formats.

articles.title: Elon Musk takes the stand in high-profile trial against OpenAI
articles.summary: Elon Musk has started his testimony in a trial against OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and president Greg Brockman, stemming from disputes over the company's structure and mission. Musk, a co-founder of OpenAI, invested up to $38 million before tensions arose among the founding team.

articles.title: Amazon launches an AI-powered audio Q&A experience on product pages
articles.summary: Amazon has introduced a "Join the chat" feature that allows customers to ask questions about products and receive AI-generated audio responses. This new functionality aims to enhance the shopping experience on product pages.

articles.title: Google expands Pentagon’s access to its AI after Anthropic’s refusal
articles.summary: Google has signed a new contract with the Pentagon to provide access to its AI technology following Anthropic's refusal to permit the Department of Defense to use its AI for domestic surveillance and autonomous weapons. This development marks a significant expansion of the military's access to Google's AI capabilities.

articles.title: ‘It’s Undignified’: Hundreds of Workers Training Meta’s AI Could Be Laid Off
articles.summary: Over 700 workers employed by a Meta contractor in Ireland face potential layoffs, according to internal documents. The affected employees are involved in training the company's AI systems.

articles.title: Recursive forecasting: Eliciting long-term forecasts from myopic fitness-seekers
articles.summary: The article discusses a method for obtaining long-term forecasts from AI models that typically focus on short-term performance, known as myopic fitness-seekers. It proposes a recursive approach where models are guided to provide better long-horizon predictions by breaking down the forecasting process into manageable steps.

articles.title: Claude can now plug directly into Photoshop, Blender, and Ableton
articles.summary: Anthropic has introduced new connectors for its AI chatbot, Claude, enabling integration with popular creative software such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Blender, and Ableton. This development follows the recent launch of Claude Design, as the company seeks to expand its presence in the creative industry.

articles.title: Lovable launches its vibe-coding app on iOS and Android
articles.summary: Lovable has launched its vibe-coding app for iOS and Android, enabling developers to code web applications and websites from mobile devices. The app aims to enhance coding flexibility and accessibility for developers on the go.

articles.title: NVIDIA Launches Nemotron 3 Nano Omni Model, Unifying Vision, Audio and Language for up to 9x More Efficient AI Agents
articles.summary: NVIDIA has introduced the Nemotron 3 Nano Omni model, which integrates vision, audio, and language processing into a single multimodal system. This innovation aims to enhance the efficiency of AI agents by providing up to nine times faster responses compared to traditional models that operate separately.

articles.title: Amazon is already offering new OpenAI products on AWS
articles.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) has announced a range of new OpenAI products, including a new agent service, following the end of Microsoft's exclusive rights to OpenAI's models. This development allows AWS to integrate and offer OpenAI's capabilities to its customers.
